caveat: One vantage point, one moment. A pointer recorded as not answering could not be retrieved from here; an endpoint recorded as refusing declined this client specifically, which a single vantage cannot distinguish from declining everyone.

exception.public_note: One member state's endpoint failed TLS validation from every one of the countries measured; its operator will be notified before it is named, and the detail is withheld until then.

world.methodology: A bare TLS probe with no SNI reports a CDN's default certificate as a defect; even with SNI, cloud routing can hand a default certificate to some vantages. Every figure here reconciles the Atlas run against a fetch of each pointer's actual URL. After reconciliation exactly one endpoint fails from every country and every method; all others validate when fetched the way software fetches them, with SNI.
